result.topic_en: Pencil calculations with products of partial derivatives (Jacobian-type expressions) of two functions m and n with respect to several variables, together with the Cauchy-Riemann equations, apparently studying Jacobians and Laplacians under conformal substitution.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\right)\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial z'}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial z'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}\right)\partial y\,\partial z\,\partial y'\,\partial z'$
$\partial m\left(\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial z'}\right)}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\frac{\partial(\;)}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial z'}\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}\right)}{\partial y'}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial(\;)}{\partial z'}\right.$
[-$\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial y}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}$-] $\frac{\partial m}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}$ [-$\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}\left(\;\frac{\partial y}{z',y'}\right)\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}\left(\;\frac{\partial y}{z',y'}\right)$-]
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial y^2}\right)-\left(\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial y^2}\right)\left(\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial z^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial m}{\partial y'}$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 m}{\partial y^2}\right)\left(\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial a^2}+\frac{\partial^2 n}{\partial b^2}\right)$
$m=f(y,z)+f'(y',z')$
$\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}=f_y(y)\quad\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}=f_z$ \quad $\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\;\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}(\;)\;\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\;\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}(\;)$
$\partial x\,\partial a\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\right)$
$\partial x\,\partial b\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\right)$
$\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial s}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial s}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial z'}\frac{\partial z'}{\partial s}{+\,+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial y'}{\partial s}+}\right)\left(\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial t}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial t}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}\frac{\partial y'}{\partial t}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial t}\right)$
$\partial y\,\partial b\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}\right)$
$\left(\partial x\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\partial y\right)\left(\partial a\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}+\partial b\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}\right)-\left(\partial x\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}-\partial y\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
$+\;\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial z}\right)\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial s}\frac{\partial y}{\partial t}-\;\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial b}\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial b}=-\frac{\partial v}{\partial a}$
$\left(\partial a\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}-\partial b\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\right)$ \quad $\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\pm\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\pm\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}i\right)$ \quad $x-yi$[?]
$+\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial z'}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y'}-\;\right)\left(\frac{\partial z'}{\partial s}\frac{\partial y'}{\partial t}\right)$
$\frac{\partial m}{\partial x\,\partial a}=-\frac{\partial u}{\partial b\,\partial y}\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial x\,\partial b}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial a\,\partial y}$
$\partial x\,\partial a\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\pm\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\;\pm\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}+\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}\frac{\partial m}{\partial z}\right)$
$+\partial x\,\partial b\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}\pm\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\pm\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}i\;\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}-\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}i$
$+\partial y\,\partial a\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\pm\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}\pm\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\right)$
$+\partial y\,\partial b\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial y}\frac{\partial n}{\partial b}\pm\frac{\partial m}{\partial b}\frac{\partial n}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial m}{\partial a}\frac{\partial n}{\partial x}\pm\frac{\partial n}{\partial a}\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}\right)$
